data.one_liner: Amplify Flutter DataStore plugin for queryable on-device data storage
data.what_it_does: Provides a local, queryable data store that syncs with AWS Amplify backend. It supports CRUD operations and offline sync across Android and iOS devices.
use_when: Need offline-capable data storage with sync to Amplify backend
Want to use Amplify DataStore API in Flutter
avoid_when: Using a different backend like Firebase
strengths: Queryable API with filtering and sorting
weaknesses: No web, Windows, macOS, or Linux support
data.setup_notes: Add package to pubspec, run flutter pub get, configure Amplify in main.dart, run pod install for iOS, rebuild app
